caption: LUM-1261 tip — interaction surface: faux turn, in-process bash, /help, /hotkeys

panels.label: 1. Ctrl+U, /model + Enter -> model selector overlay (faux + builtin providers)
2. Esc closes the selector, composer is restored
3. a real turn through the faux provider streams into the transcript
4. !local bash runs in-process and its output lands in the transcript
5. /help renders the implemented command surface + key list
7. PgUp scrolls the transcript back to the head of the /hotkeys message
8. known gap: # has no provider behind it, so no candidates appear
